title: createStorePersister
subtitle: Create a persister for qortex-store
description: Create a persistence adapter that connects qortex-store to a qortex-db instance. Enables automatic hydration on store creation and automatic persistence on every state change.

rows.name: db
rows.description: A qortex-db instance created via createDB().

rows.name: config.burstKey
rows.description: Cache-bust key. When changed, stale persisted data is discarded.

rows.name: config.storageKey
rows.description: Key used inside the DB to store the snapshot.

rows.name: config.debounceTime
rows.description: Debounce delay (ms) before writing to DB.

rows.name: config.select
rows.description: Function to select only a specific slice of state to be persisted.

returns.description: An object compatible with qortex-store's StorePersister interface.

examples.title: Basic Usage
examples.description: Enable automatic persistence for a store

callouts.title: Subpath Export
callouts.content: Import from 'qortex-db/store' to ensure better tree-shaking. The main 'qortex-db' package only exports the core DB driver.
